messages:
Ava (Finance): FYI — discovered a retro commit adjustment on the GCP Marketplace invoice for Acme Corp. Looks like their reserved seat count dropped in Dec but the marketplace applied the monthly minimum for the original commit amount and then applied an adjustment that created an unexpected chargeback. Need approval to issue a partner credit. @Miguel @Sophie placing details below.

Ava (Finance): Invoice snippet: ```Invoice: GCP-MP-2026-04567
Customer: Acme Corp
Period: 2026-02-01 to 2026-02-28
Line 1: Reserved seats (original commit 500) - $12,500
Line 2: Usage adjustment (Dec actual 320) - adjacent negative adj -$6,400
Line 3: Marketplace min-fee reconciliation chargeback - $4,800
Total due: $10,900```

Miguel (Billing): Can you confirm the net impact to Redwood revenue (not gross invoice) and whether the partner flagged this or we discovered it in reconciliation?

Ava (Finance): We flagged it in our monthly reconciliation. Net impact to Redwood is approx $3,600 (we owe partner credit after fees). Calculation attached in the ticket.

Sophie (Partner Ops): Do we have the partner contract term that covers retro adjustments? Some partners accept an internal credit memo, others require a refund request via marketplace portal. @Jamal any sales-side context with Acme?

Jamal (Cloud Sales): Acme transitioned to a lower seat tier effective 2026-12-01 per the SSO logs and sales notes. They agreed to a pro-rated change; I told them we'd reconcile. They prefer a credit on next invoice.

Miguel (Billing): OK. If the partner accepts a credit memo and the net Redwood exposure is $3.6k, I'm fine to proceed with a credit. Need PO/contract pointer or marketplace case ID for audit.

Ava (Finance): Created FIN-APPROVAL-7421 with full calc and contract excerpts. JIRA: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-7421 — includes screenshot of marketplace line items and our reconciliation sheet.

Sophie (Partner Ops): Thx. I'll reach out to the partner rep to confirm they accept credit vs cash refund. If they confirm, I'll sign off operationally and route to billing to issue credit note.

invoice-bot: Automated: Draft credit memo created CM-2026-0895 (status: draft).

Miguel (Billing): Reviewed FIN-7421 and CM-2026-0895. Impact <$5k and contract supports crediting. +1 from billing. :thumbsup:

Jamal (Cloud Sales): I'll ping the partner rep now and add confirmation to the JIRA.

Ava (Finance): Great — once Sophie confirms partner acceptance I'll move the draft to issued and update recognition entries. Thanks all.

Sophie (Partner Ops): Partner confirmed via email they accept credit memo. Routing to billing to issue CM-2026-0895.

Ava (Finance): Credit issued, updated ledger and closed FIN-7421. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
